PC: Ask for intravenous (IV) access, to have patient placed on monitor, call for nasal cannula
Obtain full history including past medical history, allergies and social history
Address low blood pressure with fluids
Obtain labs: CBC, BMP, blood cultures, lactate.  Consider obtaining a urine analysis and urine culture. Obtain CXR
Order appropriate antibiotics after considering patient’s allergies (potential antibiotics include fluoroquinolones, macrolides, tetracyclines)
MK: Entertain differential diagnoses for chest painThese may include acute coronary syndrome, pulmonary embolism, aortic dissection, cardiac tamponade
Recognize sepsis as patient is febrile, hypotensive, tachycardic and tachypneic
Accurately read the CXR as positive for a right lower lobe pneumonia and intervene appropriately
SBP: Call intensive care unit and describe case succinctly
ICS: The learner will take lead and assign clear roles
